label: GO WITH CONDITIONS
call: Turn down the $4M seed and raise the $1M from operator angels once both co-founders sign one memo. Spend it on an onboarding owner first and a closer second.

why.point: A 3x-in-18-months mandate needs 6.3% monthly growth from a company growing 4% with no paid engine.
The constraint is the CEO's 65-hour week and 2.5% churn, not cash.
Cutting churn from 2.5% to 1.5% is the cheapest growth lever on the table.

fights.story: Hormozi corrected his own prepay math and moved to B; Buffett moved back to B in Round 3.

minority.quote: Your 65 hours are the constraint, not the cash.
minority.would_have_to_be_true: 60 or more customers prepay and cash covers 12 months after both hires.

conditions: Both co-founders sign a one-page memo by October 16
Cash never below 12 months of burn

next_steps.action: Offer annual prepay to all 200 customers and call every churned customer.
Sign the memo, tell the VC no, confirm the angels.
Onboarding owner in seat, owning churn.

cheapest_test: The prepay offer plus the churn calls, before any signature.
kill_criteria: No signed memo by October 16, or churn above 2% at day 90.
